group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove group-suffixed split and reassembly helpers by induction on prefix. Use the split helper for entail_wit_1, retaining the fresh node's two undefined stores as a frame and selecting the empty-prefix or nonempty-prefix spatial orp branch. For each return witness choose the first Coq-disjunction alternative, normalize its prefix equality, reassemble the prefix, updated predecessor/sentinel, fresh node, designated node, and suffix segment, and close xizi_dll.

group_entry.grouping_reason: All three witnesses belong to the same straight-line insertion and use the same xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg split-and-reassembly family. One 3-witness group is minimal, permits reuse of the group-suffixed helpers, and is below max_witnesses_per_group=12.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: xizi_dll head (prefix ++ target :: suffix) entails the generated empty-prefix/nonempty-prefix spatial decomposition around target: in the empty case head links target and target links the suffix; in the nonempty case prefix=prefix0++[prev] and the result owns sentinel links, a prefix0 segment, prev links target, target links the suffix, and the suffix segment.

premises.premise: the target occurs at the stated prefix boundary in prefix ++ target :: suffix
premises.discharged_by: this is exactly the abstract list argument of the antecedent xizi_dll

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: The complete sentinel/prefix/predecessor/fresh-node/target/suffix decomposition produced by the insertion entails xizi_dll head (prefix ++ fresh :: target :: suffix), covering both prefix=nil (predecessor=head) and prefix=prefix0++[prev] cases.

premises.premise: prefix=prefix0++[prev] for the nonempty-prefix form, or prefix=nil with prev=head and before_prev=last for the empty-prefix form
premises.discharged_by: return_wit_1 supplies PreH1; return_wit_2 supplies PreH2, PreH3, and PreH4
premises.spatial_resource: all sentinel, prefix-segment, predecessor, fresh-node, target, and suffix resources occur explicitly in each antecedent

premises.premise: dllseg non-null/non-stop guards for inserted nodes
premises.discharged_by: valid separated field stores in the antecedent; aliasing with the sentinel or another owned node would make the antecedent inconsistent

per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_insert_before_: Apply the split helper to xizi_dll head (prefix ++ linklist_pre :: suffix), frame the two fresh-node stores, and select the helper's prefix=nil or prefix=prefix0++[prev] spatial-or branch with the exposed endpoints.

Choose the first outer disjunct, rewrite prefix=prefix0++[prev], splice the prefix0 segment with updated prev links, fresh-node links, target links, and suffix segment, retain the sentinel links, and close xizi_dll.

Choose the first outer disjunct, substitute first=linklist_pre, prefix=nil, prev=head, and before_prev=last, fold the fresh and target nodes in front of the suffix, and close xizi_dll using the updated head links already present.
